    17	import FormalConjecturesUtil
    18	
    19	/-!
    20	# Erdős Problem 479
    21	
    22	*Reference:* [erdosproblems.com/479](https://www.erdosproblems.com/479)
    23	-/
    24	
    25	namespace Erdos479
    26	
    27	/--
    28	Is it true that, for every integer $k\neq 1$, there are infinitely many $n$ such that
    29	$2^n\equiv k\pmod{n}$?
    30	-/
    31	@[category research open, AMS 11]
    32	theorem erdos_479 : answer(sorry) ↔ ∀ᵉ (k : ℤ) (k ≠ 1),
    33	    { n : ℕ | (2 : ℤ) ^ n ≡ k [ZMOD (n : ℤ)] }.Infinite := by
    34	  sorry
    35	
    36	end Erdos479
